name: Colosseum
_about: THE FLAVIAN AMPHITHEATRE at its real size on its four-centred oval (188 x 156m, the arena 86 x 54, 80 bays): the four-storey facade, three ambulatories, the three maeniana each ending on a floor, the level vomitoria out onto their walkways, the stairs along ambulatory I, the main entrances on the axes, the podium, the arena floor and the hypogeum under it. tools/archgen/colosseum.py

site._dig: the ground opened under the whole arena (its box: the corners fall under the cavea's paving): the hypogeum is under it, and its stairs come up through the boards

build: stair to the first floor parapet
stair to the second floor parapet
stair to the summa cavea parapet
upper radial zone beside the passage
upper radial zone over the passage
first maenianum below the stair's mouth
first maenianum over the long axis

ground floor._about: the paving of every ground-floor space, from the facade to the podium wall (the masses stand on it)

arena floor._about: the boards the games were fought on, over the hypogeum, the sand on them; open at each end of the long axis where a stair goes down

hypogeum wall._about: the arena's wall carried down to the hypogeum's floor: its corridors' outer wall

podium wall._about: the wall the games are fought in front of, from the sand to the podium's parapet

podium gates._about: where the minor axis's passages come out on the sand (the long axis's are three bays wide there, and have no wall)

hypogeum wall 1._about: the walls of the hypogeum's corridors, under the arena floor, doorways through them every nine metres

hypogeum stair west._about: down from the end of the arena to the hypogeum's middle corridor, under the boards

arcade I._about: the ground storey: eighty arches, each numbered over its keystone but the four on the axes

arcade II._about: the second storey, Ionic: a parapet in each arch, where a statue stood

attic._about: the attic: flat Corinthian pilasters, a window in every other bay lighting the portico behind it

attic blind._about: the attic's other bays, where the bronze shields hung

first floor._about: the floor at 10.5m, from the outer wall in

first floor over the well._about: the outer half of the floor where the stair comes up: a slab of its own, there being no vault under it

first floor well parapet._about: along the edge of the floor beside the stair's last bay

first floor well parapet inside._about: along the inner side of the hole, on the floor (the top row of the seating at the summa cavea)

first floor well parapet across._about: across the hole's end, on the flat ceiling over the bay the stair climbs through before

second floor._about: the floor at 22.4m, from the outer wall in

second floor beside the well._about: the floor inside ambulatory I where the stair comes up through it

second floor over the well._about: the outer half of the floor where the stair comes up: a slab of its own, there being no vault under it

second floor well parapet._about: along the edge of the floor beside the stair's last bay

second floor well parapet inside._about: along the inner side of the hole, on the floor (the top row of the seating at the summa cavea)

second floor well parapet across._about: across the hole's end, on the flat ceiling over the bay the stair climbs through before

summa cavea._about: the floor at 34.0m, from the outer wall in

summa cavea over the well._about: the outer half of the floor where the stair comes up: a slab of its own, there being no vault under it

summa cavea well parapet._about: along the edge of the floor beside the stair's last bay

summa cavea well parapet inside._about: along the inner side of the hole, on the floor (the top row of the seating at the summa cavea)

summa cavea well parapet across._about: across the hole's end, on the flat ceiling over the bay the stair climbs through before

ambulatory I ceiling 1._about: flat over the bay the stair climbs through, the vault left out

stair to the first floor._about: up along ambulatory I on its inner half, three bays long, into the floor above through the bay it arrives in

stair to the first floor parapet._about: the parapet on the stair's open side, stepping up with it

ambulatory I vault 2._about: the barrel vault round ambulatory I

ambulatory I ceiling 2._about: flat over the bay the stair climbs through, the vault left out

stair to the second floor._about: up along ambulatory I on its inner half, three bays long, into the floor above through the bay it arrives in

ambulatory I vault 3._about: the barrel vault round ambulatory I

ambulatory I ceiling 3._about: flat over the bay the stair climbs through, the vault left out

stair to the summa cavea parapet._about: the parapet on the stair's open side, stepping up with it

stair to the first maenianum._about: from ambulatory III up under the seating, opening in its sixth row

first maenianum over the long axis._about: over the long axis's entrances, three bays of seating carried on the passage's flat roof

portico columns._about: the colonnade round the top of the cavea, a column on every bay's line but where a stair comes up

portico roof._about: the portico's roof, against the attic: its flat top the place the velarium's sailors worked from

ground storey._about: ambulatories I-III, the radial passages between them and the solid masses round those, from the facade's middle to ring E's

first storey._about: ambulatories I and II on the first floor, to ring C's middle

first storey passages._about: the level vomitoria out through the upper radial zone onto the first walkway (the mass between them solid)

second storey._about: ambulatory I on the second floor, to just inside the third maenianum's back (its top rows over it stand clear)

second storey passages._about: the level vomitoria out through the third maenianum onto the second walkway

hypogeum._about: the corridors under the arena floor, to the middle of their outer wall

stair passage._about: the stair up under the first maenianum, from ring E's middle to where its soffit stops over the open mouth (the treads among the rows are the cavea's)

minor entrance._about: the passages of the short axis, under the seating and the podium from ring E to the podium gate

major entrance._about: the long axis's passages, three bays wide under the seating from ring E out onto the sand
